product_fixes: Contained script apps (OctoSense-org/makepad#30): every path out of an isolate answers to its policy; images/web grants; WebReader, GestureView, SheetView, CameraPreview; parse_feed and fs.read_bytes.
Host services: a host takes only its own isolates' requests, and an asynchronous answer wakes the UI.
A contained app cannot collect a secret: password and one-time-code fields are inert in a policed isolate.
Text: a run's trailing space keeps its width unless the row wraps there; every widget takes text/set_text from script.

Sockets and servers: net.web_socket answers to the app's host list like net.http_request; net.socket_stream and net.http_server are refused in a policed isolate; a Video's network and file sources answer to the host list and the storage jail.

Settings integration: Android IME synchronization, accessibility and reduced motion, GLES program-cache validation, obscured-gesture cancellation and scroll-position observation. Applied alongside the contained-app changes from source_commit.
